sources.title: Pinned Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety model card
sources.evidence: Identifies exact model, NVIDIA developer, June 2 2026 Hugging Face release, merged Gemma-3-4B-it LoRA, text/image input, text safety output, custom policy and trained reasoning modes. Governing terms are OpenMDW-1.1 plus Gemma terms and use policy. Describes nominal 4B and 128K context.

sources.title: Pinned configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma 3ForConditionalGeneration: 34 dense text layers, width 2560, vocabulary 262208, FFN 10240, eight query/four KV heads of 256 dimensions; 29 sliding and five full attention layers. SigLIP has 27 layers, width 1152, FFN 4304, image 896/patch 14, no pooling head. Context 131072.

sources.title: Pinned checkpoint index
sources.evidence: 883 tensor names mapped to five shards; metadata.total_parameters=4300079472 and metadata.total_size=8600158944. Both independently matched to exact config/code shapes and bounded shard headers.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor headers, first of five
sources.evidence: Read all five shards using separate HTTP 206 ranges for eight-byte length and exact JSON header. All 883 tensors are BF16 learned parameters, with every name/shape/offset reconciled to code/config. Complete count 4300079472; no stored buffers, quantization scales, packed tensors, unmerged adapters or MTP parameters.

sources.title: Gemma3 implementation at configured Transformers version
sources.evidence: Defines dense gated MLP, GQA projections, four per-layer RMS norms and q/k norms, tied LM head, multimodal projection and norm. Checkpoint key conversion maps the saved legacy prefixes. Rotary frequencies and embedding scale are nonpersistent buffers.

sources.title: Gemma3 configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Text config defaults tie_word_embeddings=true, establishing the absent lm_head tensor shares the saved token embedding. Uses configured dense Gemma 3/SigLIP architecture.

sources.title: SigLIP implementation at configured Transformers version
sources.evidence: Vision patch convolution, learned positions,27encoder layers with biased attention/MLPs and norms; no optional pooling head when vision_use_head=false. Position IDs are a nonpersistent buffer, not learned parameters.

sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator technical report
sources.evidence: August 27 report describes Gemma 3-4B foundation, combined image/text and custom-policy input, and reasoning trace supervision with /think and /no_think modes. Provides no separately defined active parameter count. Appendix A rank 8 differs from model-card rank 16; both describe merged fine-tuning, so no extra adapters are added to checkpoint total. ArXiv abstract page lists only v1.

sources.title: Pinned safety and reasoning template
sources.evidence: Builds moderation prompts from text, optional image and assistant response, supports custom policy/taxonomy and enable_thinking, default false. Uses 24 safety categories including economic harm; no tool-call serialization or execution protocol is defined.

sources.title: NVIDIA Build model card and endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct Markdown and page metadata give exact 4300079472 parameters,131072 context and text/image to text. Capability metadata claims function calling supported, contradicting NIM release documentation. Build release is June 2, while its March 16 HF/NGC dates and older overview conflict with exact 3.5 HF card and retain predecessor information.

sources.title: NVIDIA release article on Hugging Face
sources.evidence: June 4 publication announces 3.5 and describes configurable reasoning/custom policy on Gemma 3-4B. Conflicts with exact model card on license wording (older NVIDIA Open Model License),23 versus current 24 categories, and release-day wording; current card governs those specifications.

sources.title: Contemporary model-date correction
sources.evidence: June 1 commit changes model date from May 2026 to June 2, 2026, corroborating the intended release date stated by current card; repo creation/upload history alone is not treated as public release evidence.

sources.title: OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1
sources.evidence: Actual agreement linked by both exact card and Build page; title/version OpenMDW-1.1. Applied in addition to Gemma derivative terms, not as a replacement for them.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Terms cover Gemma 3 and model derivatives, explicitly referenced by NVIDIA3.5 card.

sources.title: Gemma Prohibited Use Policy
sources.evidence: Additional use policy explicitly incorporated by the exact NVIDIA card alongside Gemma Terms.

sources.title: NVIDIA NIM2.0.5-variant release notes
sources.evidence: Exact3.5 entry says function(tool)calling and guided decoding are unsupported; this documents that NIM release, not every possible use of the raw checkpoint. Image-only requests unsupported: text must accompany images.

name.note: Exact 3.5 variant; separate from Nemotron 3 Content Safety and older Content Safety Reasoning 4B.

developer.note: NVIDIA developed this fine-tune; Google is the explicitly identified base-model developer.

family.note: NVIDIA markets the model under Nemotron 3.5; Gemma 3 is its architecture and base lineage.

release_date.note: Exact card gives June 2 HF release and Build gives June 2 endpoint release; contemporary June 1 card edit confirms June 2 model date. June 4 announcement is later. Build March 16 HF/NGC dates conflict with exact card and correspond to predecessor context. May 22 repo creation is not proof of public availability.

open_weights.note: Full merged checkpoint is publicly downloadable; all five shard headers accessed without authentication.

license.note: Both current exact cards name OpenMDW 1.1 and Gemma Terms plus Gemma Prohibited Use Policy. Release blog uses older NVIDIA license wording; do not transfer that to current checkpoint or omit Gemma restrictions.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete count 4300079472 across 883 BF16 learned tensors: language 3880263168, vision 416866032, projector 2950272. Tied input/output embedding counted once. All tensor names, shapes, dtypes and contiguous offsets reconstructed from config/code. No persistent buffers, quantization, extra unmerged LoRA or MTP; nominal 4B is rounded model tier.

active_parameters_b.note: Exact model card, later technical report and release article do not separately define active parameters. Dense decoding does not justify equating total multimodal checkpoint count with per-token activity: vision input and processing phase differ.

architecture.note: Dense Gemma 3 decoder with 34 layers (29 sliding, 5 full attention), SigLIP 27-layer vision encoder and multimodal projector; no routed experts. Generates labels and optional traces via tied language head.

context_window.note: Card 128K resolved to 131072 by exact config and Build explicit numeric specification; avoid baseline decimal 128000. Report 8000 is fine-tuning sequence length, not supported context maximum.

modalities.note: Text and an optional single image; output text labels and optional reasoning trace. NIM requires text with images; no audio/video or image output is claimed.

reasoning.note: Explicit reasoning trace supervision and evaluated /think mode; exact template enable_thinking supports on/off, default off. This is direct 3.5 evidence, not inherited from predecessor.

tool_call.note: Conflicting primary claims: Build capability metadata says supported; NIM 2.0.5-variant explicitly says unsupported. Exact checkpoint template is specialized for safety labels/traces and has no tool protocol, but absence is not proof of incapability. Clear model-wide baseline false pending checkpoint-level evidence.

description.value: NVIDIA fine-tune of Gemma 3 4B for classifying text and image safety, with custom policies and optional reasoning traces.
description.note: Uses concrete documented inputs and functions; removes unsupported risk-aware routing phrasing.

patch.description: NVIDIA fine-tune of Gemma 3 4B for classifying text and image safety, with custom policies and optional reasoning traces.
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint contains 4.300079472B learned parameters, including the vision encoder and projector; 4B is nominal. Active parameters are not separately defined. Context is 131072 tokens. Governing terms are OpenMDW-1.1 plus Gemma Terms and Gemma Prohibited Use Policy. The current card dates release June 2, 2026; June 4 is the launch article. Build function-calling metadata conflicts with NIM documentation, so model-wide tool capability remains unverified.

parameter_count_reproduction.method: Read exactly 8 bytes then exact JSON header from each of 5 pinned shards using HTTP 206 ranges. Reconstruct all 883 expected parameter shapes from pinned config and Transformers 4.57.1 Gemma 3/SigLIP source. Match exact key set, BF16 dtype, every shape and contiguous data offset; compare independent formula component sums and index metadata. No full weight payload downloaded.

formulas.language: V*D + L*(2*D*Q + 2*D*K + 3*D*I + 4*D + 2*H) + D; D=2560,V=262208,L=34,Q=2048,K=1024,I=10240,H=256. Tied LM head adds no second embedding.

parameter_count_reproduction.buffer_handling: Gemma embedding scale, rotary frequencies and SigLIP position IDs are nonpersistent buffers absent from checkpoint. Every saved tensor matches an nn.Parameter; learned norms and learned vision positions retained.

summary: All 14 fields reviewed for exact 3.5 checkpoint. Add complete 4.300079472B learned count, dense Gemma 3/SigLIP architecture, current OpenMDW 1.1+Gemma license and 131072 context. Confirm June 2 release, open weights, text/image input, text output and trained optional reasoning. Active count remains undisclosed; clear unsupported model-wide tool false because primary claims conflict. Reconciled all 883 tensors across 5 shards without downloading weights.
